On 03/26/2015 12:51 AM, Nitin Labhishetty wrote:
> What is required is this field? Will the contact of any faculty member
> from my college suffice?

A faculty member (with their school email) who is familiar with you and
your knowledge of R would be preferred. Ideally, that faculty member
can be located by a google search on the 'Faculty' pages of the university.

If selected, students need to validate their educational status to
Google's satisfaction. Sometimes the R GSoC administrators also choose
to validate student information by contacting someone at the university.

Regards,

Brian
